title: Zelensky names spy boss chief to head presidential administration in big shakeup

contentText: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy named Ukraine's military intelligence chief Kyrylo Budanov as his top adviser on Friday and proposed a drone and digitalisation specialist as defence minister. The appointments were made as Kyiv seeks to strengthen its hand in U.S.-backed talks to end its nearly four-year-old conflict with Russia. France24 correspondent from Ukraine, Emmanuele Chaze, tells us the latest.
